description: Label map for the grouped scheme: AML-MR and AML_MECOM-r are trained as one class, AML_other, which scripts/predict.py reports as 'AML, no specific subtype' (configs/class_hierarchy.json lists it under no_subtype_classes). Raw labels of other AML without a methylation class of their own, for example AML NOS arrays if they are added to the training pickle, can be mapped to AML_other here; a mapped label is no longer removed by EXCLUDE_PREFIXES, which acts on the labels after this map. The map is saved with each model and applied to ONT truth files, so a truth label listed here is scored against AML_other. Also contains every merge of configs/label_map.json. Use with --label_map configs/label_map_aml_other.json.
